works.title: A split-control criterion for few-shot adaptation in single-cell perturbation prediction
PIE: Generalizing perturbation effects across unseen perturbations, contexts and datasets

new_design_changes: Separate zero-shot context/perturbation/joint and cross-dataset tests from calibration-based few-shot adaptation.
Add calibration-only empirical release versus retaining pooled-source predictions, with frozen adapter and scoring convention.
Split controls by independent experimental units where available; disjoint cells alone do not establish biological independence.
Preserve undefined PCC and complete paired scoring rows instead of zero-filling or dropping failures.
Pin PIE split/source revisions and audit actual training rows and evidence, rather than treating a target data directory as proof of training leakage.
remaining_limitations: Only five author-released source/configuration documents were read, not the two manuscript PDFs.
